page.title: Automations
page.description: Workflows that react to events and time and run actions on records without code.
page.emptyDescription: Start from a ready-made example or build a workflow from scratch.
page.noAccessDescription: Ask an administrator for permission to manage automations.

skipReasons.record_not_accessible: Record is outside the publisher's access
skipReasons.publisher_unavailable: The publisher is no longer available

toast.restored: Version {{version}} loaded into the draft. Save to keep it.

create.title: New automation
create.description: Pick a ready-made example to adapt or start from scratch.
create.blankDescription: Choose the record type and trigger, then build the steps in the editor.
create.unavailable: Trigger or record type unavailable in this organization.
create.name: Name
create.exampleSummary: {{type}} · {{trigger}}. The automation is created as a draft; review it in the editor before publishing.

follow_up_proposal.name: Follow up on sent proposal
follow_up_proposal.description: When a deal enters Proposal, is still open and has no follow-up task, creates a task due in 2 days for the owner.

stale_deal.name: Deal stalled for 7 days
stale_deal.description: Notifies the manager when an open deal goes 7 days without updates.

wait_then_task.name: Reach out again in 2 days
wait_then_task.description: Waits 2 days after the deal is created and, if it is still open, creates a task for the owner.
wait_then_task.waitLabel: Wait 2 days and check it is still open

welcome_contact.name: First touch with new contact
welcome_contact.description: Creates a first-touch task for the owner when a contact is added.

deal_won.name: Celebrate won deal
deal_won.description: Notifies the owner when the deal is won.
deal_won.notificationBody: Congratulations! The deal was marked as won.

editor.name: Automation name
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the goal of this automation (optional)
editor.deleteDescription: The automation's versions, run history and secrets will also be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
editor.issues_one: {{count}} issue found. Blocks with errors are highlighted in the workflow.
editor.issues_other: {{count}} issues found. Blocks with errors are highlighted in the workflow.
editor.flowHint: Click a block to configure it and use + to add steps. The latest published version is always what runs.
editor.conflictTitle: The automation was changed by someone else
editor.conflictDescription: Reload to see the latest version. Your unsaved changes will be discarded.

panel.triggerDescription: What starts the automation and with which options.
panel.label: Step name
panel.labelPlaceholder: Optional, shown in the workflow and history
panel.conditionHint: If the conditions are not met, the run ends at this step without an error. "Trigger" fields use the event that fired it (previous value, changed fields).
panel.branchHint: Follows the first path whose conditions are met.
panel.otherwiseHint: If no path matches, it follows "Otherwise" (which can be left empty).

waitModeHints.duration: E.g.: wait 2 days after the trigger.
waitModeHints.field: E.g.: 1 day before the expected close date.

panel.offsetHint: Leave empty to resume exactly on the field's date.
panel.recheckHint: When resuming, the run only continues if these conditions are still true (e.g.: deal still open).
panel.waitUntilHint: The conditions are rechecked periodically. When they match, it follows "Condition met".
panel.timeoutHint: When it runs out, it follows "Timed out" (empty ends the run).
panel.waitingHint: What to do with runs held at wait steps.

options.cancel_waiting_on_pause: Cancel waiting runs when the automation is paused
options.cancel_waiting_on_publish: Cancel waiting runs when a new version is published

panel.removeBranchTitle: Remove this step and its paths?
panel.removeBranchDescription: All steps inside the paths will also be removed from the draft.

conditions.relatedHint: E.g.: "there is no open follow-up task".

variables.triggerActorId: ID of who made the change
variables.triggerActorType: Type of who made the change

record_created.label: Record created
record_created.description: When a record of this type is created.

record_updated.label: Record updated
record_updated.description: When a record is changed; restrict it to specific fields if you want.

record_deleted.label: Record deleted
record_deleted.description: When a record is deleted (conditions about it evaluate to false).

deal_stage_changed.label: Deal stage changed
deal_stage_changed.description: When the deal enters (or leaves) a stage.

deal_won.label: Deal won
deal_won.description: When the deal is marked as won.

deal_lost.label: Deal lost
deal_lost.description: When the deal is marked as lost.

activity_completed.label: Activity completed
activity_completed.description: When an activity is completed (on the records linked to it).

note_created.label: Note created
note_created.description: When a note is added to the record.

manual.label: Manual
manual.description: Only runs when someone starts it on a record.

incoming_webhook.label: Incoming webhook
incoming_webhook.description: When an incoming webhook creates or updates the record.

time_date_relative.label: Record date
time_date_relative.description: A period before or after a date field (e.g.: 3 days before the expected close).

time_record_stale.label: Stalled record
time_record_stale.description: When the record goes days without updates, without activity or in the same stage.

time_deal_rotting.label: Deal rotting in stage
time_deal_rotting.description: When an open deal goes past the stage day limit (once per stage entry).

time_schedule.label: Scheduled
time_schedule.description: At set times, for each record matching the filter or segment.

create_task.label: Create task
create_task.description: Creates a task linked to the record.

update_fields.label: Update fields
update_fields.description: Changes record fields (empty clears the field).

add_tag.label: Add tag
add_tag.description: Adds a tag to the record.

remove_tag.label: Remove tag
remove_tag.description: Removes a tag from the record.

move_stage.label: Move stage
move_stage.description: Moves the deal to a stage (stage requirements still apply).

create_note.label: Create note
create_note.description: Adds a note to the record.

send_notification.label: Send notification
send_notification.description: Shows an in-app notification to the recipients.

send_email.label: Send email
send_email.description: Sends an email to the recipients, according to their preferences.

call_webhook.label: Call webhook
call_webhook.description: Sends a JSON POST to an external URL.

create_related_record.label: Create related record
create_related_record.description: Creates a record of another type and optionally links it to the current one.

assign_by_rule.label: Assign by rule
assign_by_rule.description: Assigns the owner using a lead distribution rule.

enroll_in_sequence.label: Enroll in sequence
enroll_in_sequence.description: Enrolls the contact in a sequence; e-mails go out from the mailbox of the owner or of whoever published the automation.

hints.due_in: Due time counted from the run.
hints.due_at: Use a date variable, e.g.: In 2 days. Ignored if a due time is set.
hints.fields: Leave empty to trigger on any change.
hints.retry_safe: Check only if receiving the same call twice does not cause a duplicate effect.
hints.cron: Format: second minute hour day month day-of-week.
hints.segment_id: Optional; limits to records in the segment.
hints.relationship: Optional; keeps the new record linked to the current one.

issues.needsAction: At least one action is required to publish.
issues.unreachable: This step cannot be reached from the start.

test.title: Test with a record
test.description: Runs the workflow in simulation mode: conditions are actually evaluated and actions only show what they would do.
test.useDraftHint: Uncheck to test the published version.
test.neverPublished: There is no published version yet; the test uses the draft.
test.willSave: Unsaved changes will be saved before the test.
test.queued: Run queued. Follow it in the Runs tab.
test.noEffects: The test does not save anything or send messages.

outcomes.waiting: Would pause at a wait step

test.recordUnavailable: The record is not available to the automation.
test.empty: Choose a record and run the test to see each step.

timeline.stoppedByCondition: The run ended here because the condition was not met.

runs.emptyDescription: Runs appear here when the published automation is triggered.

versions.emptyDescription: Publish the draft to create the first version.
versions.restoreDescription: The current draft will be replaced in the editor. Nothing changes in what is running until you save and publish.
